introC108: Review amounts and issues before requesting closure.
unsavedC108: Record or discard pending fields and save the review before closing.
exceptionC108: Issues reviewed locally by the responsible person
managerNeededC108: Ask the responsible person to review the issues.
saveFailedC108: Could not save. Changes remain on screen.
changedFinal108: The data changed. Review again and check the confirmation.
ackExceptionC108: I checked the count and issues and confirm the responsible person’s local review.
ackC108: I checked the counted cash and payments shown in this review.
previewC108: Review preview — not confirmation that the drawer is closed.
localC108: Official expected balance and difference depend on the drawer response. A receipt does not confirm bank settlement.
followC108: Follow the result on the drawer screen. Sending this request does not confirm closure.
actionFailedC108: Could not generate the document. Try again.
invalidSource108: Received data could not be validated. Refresh before closing.
helpEmptyC108: No sales loaded. Check the query before proceeding; unknown values are not zero.
